parameters.jsCode: const fallbackImage='https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tha0rbej/hanoixanh/main/anh-chien-dich-kenh-muong.png';const draft=$('Get Draft').first().json;const version=$input.first().json;if(!draft.id)return[{json:{status:'not_found',message:'Không tìm thấy draft với draft_id đã cung cấp.'}}];if(!version.id)return[{json:{status:'version_not_found',draft_id:draft.id,version:draft.current_version}}];const parse=v=>{if(Array.isArray(v))return v;if(typeof v==='string'){try{return JSON.parse(v)}catch(e){return[]}}return[]};const validImage=v=>{try{return new URL(String(v||'').trim()).protocol==='https:'}catch(e){return false}};const rawImages=parse(version.images);const images=rawImages.filter(x=>validImage(typeof x==='string'?x:x?.url)).map(x=>typeof x==='string'?{url:x}:x);const website={...(version.website_payload||{})};const threads={...(version.threads_payload||{})};const imageUrl=[website.image_url,threads.image_url,...images.map(x=>x.url)].map(x=>String(x||'').trim()).find(validImage)||fallbackImage;website.image_url=imageUrl;threads.image_url=imageUrl;const storedImages=images.length?images:[{url:fallbackImage,caption:'Ảnh chiến dịch Hà Nội Xanh',source_url:fallbackImage,license_status:'project_asset'}];return[{json:{status:'ok',draft:{...draft,draft_id:draft.id,version:draft.current_version,website_payload:website,threads_payload:threads,images:storedImages,sources:version.sources||[],preview_url:version.preview_url,file_url:version.file_url}}}];
